title: Shinonome Akito — Return To Regular Life〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Restaurant

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
This place has a nice atmosphere...
And the dishes at the other tables look amazing.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I guarantee that you're going to like the food here. I already ordered some things, and they should be here soon...
se_walk_men_004_1

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line: “Thank you for your patience.”

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Oh, food's here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa, you guys ordered all this?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Fried chicken, hot dogs, French fries, pizza, Caesar salad and there's still more...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, these are just the appetizers, so lose that deer-in-the-headlights look. You guys are still young, so you should have no trouble getting through this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Who wants some salad?

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Me!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm glad that Taiga and Ken ordered for us. There's so much on this menu that I don't think we would've been able to choose...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hm? What's this meat dish called again?
It looks like a Salisbury steak...

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Oh, that's meatloaf.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Basically, you take the meat for a Salisbury steak, put it in a mold and in the oven.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Want some sour cream to go with it?
The stuff they make here is very good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I see.
Then, I'll have some.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...!
This is ridiculously good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I've tried a lot of different dishes since coming here. Giant hamburgers, tacos, lambchops...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (You don't see those things much in Japan, but they've all been amazing, and definitely worth trying out.)

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Oh, Akito, that meat pie you're having looks good. Can I have one?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, here.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Thanks! In return, I'll give you something from our table. I recommend...

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Oh, how about this pot pie?
It's packed with chicken and really delicious!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You don't say. Sure, I'll have some.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (You eat pot pies by breaking the top crust and eating it with the stew underneath, right...?)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Hey, uh—

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Huh?!)

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Hm? What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nothing's wrong... It's just, this stew stuff...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (This vague grassy taste and slight sweetness. These have to be...)

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Oh, I see...are carrots not your thing?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Sorry, Akito, I should've asked if there was anything you didn't want to eat before I passed it over.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I mean, it's not that big a deal...
If anything, it's my fault for not telling you first.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
I was also too slow to notice.
Akito here isn't all that fond of carrots.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
To be fair, this smells pretty spicy...
You can't really tell that it's carrot potage just at a glance.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: Also, An gave Kohane the tomatoes on her plate a second ago.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, you saw?

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: Yes. You two must be really close.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Everyone has their likes and dislikes.
Humans should just have what they want.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Then, I'll take that from you!
Here, have some of this pizza instead!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry, and thanks.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Yeah, there's no need to force yourself or anything.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: But I am of the mind that overcoming your dislikes can help expand your list of options.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, maybe so...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Haha. Your expression says, “Life wouldn't be so hard if that were so easy.” I understand how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Still, you did manage to get the hang of English, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I've still got a lot of work to do. But yes, things have gotten better on that front...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: It's easy to overcome these sorts of dislikes once you reach a certain level of familiarity.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Who knows? If you worked hard enough, you might even grow to like carrots...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, that sounds like...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, Dad, that's enough.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
Ken may be right.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? Don't tell me...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Just look at how much you've improved at English. If you approached eating carrots with the same effort, then...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Look what you've done! Now you've got Toya saying the same thing!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Sorry, you two. That was meant to be a joke.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
(That was seriously a close one...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Now, I'm not calling this an apology for teasing you...
But this place has a pretty huge dessert menu.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: How about we order some pancakes?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, please...
